tasks.label: Build All (via scripts/build.ps1)
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/build.ps1 -Mod LimbTweaks -SkipDeploy -SkipPackage; if($?) { powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/build.ps1 -Mod SquadCommand -SkipDeploy -SkipPackage }

tasks.label: Deploy LimbTweaks
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$src='${workspaceFolder}/LimbTweaks/bin/Release/net6.0/ER2_LimbTweaks.dll'; $dst='E:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Easy Red 2/BepInEx/plugins/ER2_LimbTweaks.dll'; $deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(5); $ok=$false; while((Get-Date)-lt $deadline){ try { Copy-Item $src $dst -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $ok=$true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10 } }; if($ok){ Write-Host 'Deployed' } else { Write-Host 'FAILED: locked' }; Remove-Item 'E:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Easy Red 2/BepInEx/config/er2.limbtweaks.cfg' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"

tasks.label: Deploy WeatherControl
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$src='${workspaceFolder}/WeatherControl/bin/Release/net6.0/ER2_WeatherControl.dll'; $dst='E:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Easy Red 2/BepInEx/plugins/ER2_WeatherControl.dll'; $deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(5); $ok=$false; while((Get-Date)-lt $deadline){ try { Copy-Item $src $dst -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $ok=$true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10 } }; if($ok){ Write-Host 'Deployed' } else { Write-Host 'FAILED: locked' }; Remove-Item 'E:/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Easy Red 2/BepInEx/config/er2.weathercontrol.cfg' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
